currentSummary: M14.6 adds owner-bound original 7-Zip Browse/Unicode-path and cross-app clipboard previews, actual shared RAM sections, and exact native UTF-8/CRLF editor reopening. Full GUI archive operations, normal C++ cancellation, Notepad++/Sumatra interfaces and Firefox execution remain unqualified. All original target tasks remain mandatory in M14.12; whole-system CPU/RAM/storage optimization blocks final M14.15. Native/source/media qualification passes with 76 native and 19 host groups across 96 campaign tasks. All twenty public downloads pass independent hash verification; public content/link evidence is recorded separately in evidence/M14/6; advanced BrixCanvas search/task navigation remains reported and unqualified. Browser choices can download the original Firefox installer; Firefox installation and execution are not supported yet. The retained private Windows processes run without an embedded Windows guest. M14.15 remains the mandatory whole-system optimization gate.
currentImageAlt: Actual Engacer OS M14.6: unchanged original 7-Zip Browse opens the native owner-bound Unicode Save dialog; preview tasks only.
reportedPlatformLimit: BrixCanvas currently omits the saved same-page search and article navigation. Browse the task guides and archive; this reported platform limitation does not block OS milestones.
